drivingQuestion: Is suspending a strainer a Torah-level labor?
outcomeNote: Abaye's rabbinic-prohibition answer replaces Rav Yosef's.

segments.he: אֲמַר לֵיהּ אַבָּיֵי: אֶלָּא מֵעַתָּה, תְּלָא כּוּזָא בְּסִיכְּתָא הָכִי נָמֵי דְּמִיחַיַּיב?!
segments.en: «Abaye said to him: But if» that is «so,» that an action of that sort constitutes performance of the prohibited labor of building by Torah law, then if «one suspended a jug on a peg, is he also liable» for building a tent?

segments.he: אֶלָּא אָמַר אַבָּיֵי: מִדְּרַבָּנַן הִיא, שֶׁלֹּא יַעֲשֶׂה כְּדֶרֶךְ שֶׁהוּא עוֹשֶׂה בַּחוֹל.
segments.en: «Rather, Abaye said: It is a rabbinic» decree issued so «that one will not conduct» himself on Shabbat «in the manner that he conducts» himself «during the week.»

segments.he: מְנַקֵּיט אַבָּיֵי חוּמְרֵי מַתְנְיָתָא וְתָנֵי: הַגּוֹד וְהַמְשַׁמֶּרֶת, כִּילָּה וְכִסֵּא גַלִּין — לֹא יַעֲשֶׂה, וְאִם עָשָׂה — פָּטוּר אֲבָל אָסוּר. אׇהֳלֵי קְבַע — לֹא יַעֲשֶׂה, וְאִם עָשָׂה — חַיָּיב חַטָּאת. אֲבָל מִטָּה וְכִסֵּא טְרַסְקָל וְאַסְלָא — מוּתָּר לִנְטוֹתָן לְכַתְּחִילָּה.
segments.en: «Abaye would consolidate the principles of the baraitot» pertaining to the construction of a tent on Shabbat «and teach:» With regard to «a large wineskin, a» wine «strainer, a canopy» hung over a bed, «and a folding chair» whose cover is detached from its legs, «one may not assemble» them due to the prohibition against making a temporary tent. «If one did» so unwittingly, «he is exempt» by Torah law from bringing a sin-offering, «but» it is «prohibited» by rabbinic decree. With regard to «permanent tents, one may not make» them, «and if he did» so, «he is liable to» bring «a sin-offering» for performing the prohibited labor of building. «However,» with regard to «a bed, and a folding chair [teraskal]» whose cover is attached to its legs, «and a» collapsible «toilet, it is permissible to open them ab initio,» since they are prepared for use from before Shabbat.

moves.summary: Then hanging a jug on a peg would be liable?!
moves.about: if suspending a strainer is Torah-level building, hanging a jug on a peg would also be liable

moves.summary: Rather: a rabbinic decree against weekday conduct.
